transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue before we finalize the rollout. While tracing a separate permissions bug yesterday, I found that 23 legacy admin endpoints update permissions without emitting the invalidation event that the new cache consumes. I've been confirming which endpoints still use that path, which is why I haven't filed the adapter work yet. The rollout plan must include a binding commitment to build and verify an invalidation adapter for those 23 endpoints before we expand beyond the initial cohort.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share findings from the load rehearsal I ran this morning. Invalidation-queue propagation measured at a 9-minute p95, and the queue stays within its safe operating limit only if the first rollout cohort is capped at 10 percent. Additionally, the authorization cache lifetime must be set to exactly 300 seconds for this rollout. I haven't updated the rollout ticket yet because the rehearsal finished after the change-control review began, so I'm flagging it here now.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share a finding from a support-case review I completed. All 11 SCIM-managed enterprise accounts use an admin workflow that cannot yet explain delayed permission changes. These accounts must be excluded from the first rollout cohort, and a support playbook must be prepared before they are enabled. I hadn't posted this yet because the cases were being reassigned between support queues, but given we're finalizing flag settings, I need to flag it now.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Build and verify an invalidation adapter for the 23 legacy admin endpoints that update permissions without emitting the invalidation event, before expanding beyond the initial 10% rollout cohort.
Prepare a support playbook for SCIM-managed enterprise accounts explaining delayed permission changes before those accounts are enabled in any future rollout cohort.

Update the rollout ticket with the load rehearsal findings: 9-minute p95 invalidation-queue propagation and the 10% cohort cap, and monitor queue depth against safe operating limits during the Monday rollout.
